title: Evaluation bound for the cylinder on a pulled-back test form
statement: Assume (VO), the vanishing-off-support antecedent: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; (REP), the mass-representation antecedent: for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ (μ(Uᶜ) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for every open W, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω, and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0; (L1) |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| for every continuous linear A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and k-covector β on ℝ^{N'}; (L2) |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| for v ∈ ℝ^N and every (k+1)-covector β on ℝ^N (exact frozen Lean types, written as antecedents). Let cyl_{N,k} : 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) be an arbitrary family of currents on univ satisfying (9) for cyl: for every X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ and every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is η ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x, v and cyl(X)(ω) = X(η). Let N, N', k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞, β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and a, b, c ∈ ℝ with b ≥ 0, such that for every x ∈ spt X and t ∈ [0, 1] there are a (k+1)-covector γ on ℝ^{N'} and a continuous linear D : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} with β(ι(t, x)) = γ.compContinuousLinearMap D, |γ| ≤ c, ‖De₀‖ ≤ a and ‖D(Jv)‖ ≤ b‖v‖ for all v. Then |cyl(X)(β)| ≤ b^k·a·c·M(X), with M(X) taken as a real number (ENNReal.toReal).
